# Pinecrest Mountain Rentals — Summer Direct-Booking Campaign Calendar

**Generated by: Marketing & Distribution skill**
**Window:** May 12, 2026 – Sep 5, 2026 (17 weeks)
**Marketing lead:** Priya Shah
**Direct list:** ~3,200 past guests + ~1,800 leads from /owners + market pages
**Hero campaign:** "Summer at Altitude — Park City + Jordanelle"

---

## Strategic Frame

Direct-booking share is at 68% (target 70%). Summer is when we close that gap, because: (1) repeat guests from the prior ski season are deciding their summer trip in May–June, (2) Jordanelle lake season is a 5-month window we can own (May 23 – Oct 15), and (3) Memorial Day + July 4 weekends are the two highest-margin booking moments of the year.

The campaign builds two distinct narratives:
- **"Park City is for cabins"** — for the mountain segment (cabins + condos), targeting families and couples
- **"Lake season is here"** — for Jordanelle, targeting families with school-age kids and boating enthusiasts

## Three Highest-Leverage Moments

### Moment 1 — Week 2 (May 18–24): Lake-Season Opening Email

**Why it matters:** Memorial Day is the single most important booking moment for the Jordanelle segment (4 properties = 17% of portfolio revenue). Last year's lake-season opening email (sent May 19, 2025) drove 41 direct bookings + $94K in revenue over 4 weeks.

**Plan:**
- **Subject line A/B:** "Lake season is officially here" vs. "Jordanelle opens this Friday — first weekend already booking up"
- **Hero image:** Reservoir Bluff (PC-22) deck + lake shot at sunset (Lumen 2025 archive photo)
- **3 paragraphs:** (1) "Lake's open Friday May 23. Here's the booking math." (2) Property availability snapshot. (3) Direct-booking advantage callout (15% off vs. Airbnb).
- **Send time:** Wed May 20, 9 AM MT (best historical open rate for our list)
- **Segments:** Full direct list (3,200) + lake-affinity tag (1,200)
- **Backup ad spend:** $1,800 in Meta retargeting for non-clickers

### Moment 2 — Week 6 (Jun 15–21): July 4 Last-Chance Email

**Why it matters:** July 4 weekend is our #1 revenue weekend of the year (~$78K combined). Last year we filled all 24 properties; this year we're at 21/24 booked already (3 cabins available May 12). Last-chance urgency converts hard.

**Plan:**
- **Subject line:** "3 cabins left for July 4 weekend"
- **Hero:** Hawkfeather Cabin twilight exterior (post-re-shoot)
- **Tactic:** countdown timer in email (booked-by Sunday June 21) + scarcity ("only 3 left of our 24 properties")
- **Send time:** Tue Jun 16, 6 PM MT (evening — when family planners are home)
- **Segments:** Full direct list, with stronger emphasis on family-with-kids

### Moment 3 — Week 15 (Aug 17–23): Labor Day Email

**Why it matters:** End-of-summer last hurrah — competing with school start. Last year Labor Day weekend filled in 96 hours of campaign launch. This year we want all 24 properties booked.

**Plan:**
- **Subject line:** "Last weekend of summer — Labor Day in Park City"
- **Hero:** Multiple-property collage with mountain + lake split
- **Tactic:** "Last X spots in your favorite property type" (segmentation-driven copy)
- **Send time:** Mon Aug 17, 9 AM MT
- **Segments:** Full list with property-type segmentation in dynamic content

- Direct-booking volume (total, by property, by source-attribution)
- Email metrics (sent, open, click, conversion)
- Paid metrics (impressions, CTR, CPM, conversion, ROAS)

- Comp-set RevPAR delta

**Mid-summer review:** Jul 6 (post-July 4) — re-tune all paid spend allocation for back half. Kill what's not working.
